shell_command_blocks.command:
gh label create question --color d876e3 --description "Question from a VM lane" 2>/dev/null || true
for f in $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD^ HEAD -- coord/questions); do
  title=$(sed -n 's/^title: //p' "$f" | head -1)
  { echo '```'; sed -n '1,/^---$/p' "$f" | sed '$d'; echo '```'; sed '1,/^---$/d' "$f"; } > body.md
  gh issue create --title "Q: $title" --label question --body-file body.md
done
